experiment: DCF-19B decision-margin signals for regime-level routing
world: DCF-15 mesh, cost model and lambda unchanged; DCF-19 accounting (one kernel launch per step)
candidates: regime19 (DCF-19 rule, tau fixed at 2); probe (BP on the epoch-start queries; exact for the epoch if the fraction of queries within delta of 0.8 or 0.2 is >= phi; probe BP kernel charged when exact is chosen); lagged (same fraction over the previous epoch's returned posteriors; epoch 0 uses BP)
selection: single policy with the highest mean objective_total over the four DCF-15 development conditions (DCF-15 dev seeds), frozen in selection19b.json before the held-out traces exist
why_fresh_seeds: DCF-19's held-out results (seed base 450000) motivated this experiment, so they are development evidence now; 19B's held-out conditions use unseen seeds

gates.R1: selected policy objective_total exceeds fixed_bp in more held-out conditions than it falls below
gates.R2: selected policy within 0.001 of the better of fixed_bp and fixed_exact in at least 4 of 6 held-out conditions
gates.R3: selected policy objective_total exceeds the DCF-19 regime rule in more held-out conditions than it falls below
